built and published.meaning: A program was built for this platform, packaged, and published to npm. You can install it and run it.

compiler checked only.covers: the memory engine's source only, not the client libraries
compiler checked only.meaning: A compiler check is a check and not a build. The compiler accepts the memory engine's source for this target when it is asked from a Mac, and that is the whole of the claim. Nothing was ever assembled into a program by it, nothing was linked, and nothing has been run there on the strength of it. Three of the four targets below were later built, packaged and published, and they appear again under 'built and published'; Windows on x86_64 was not, and creating a vault there is refused on purpose until that work is done.

does not establish: that anything has been run on a platform listed only as built and published
that an installer, a credential store or an editor has been tried there
that a program was ever built for a platform listed only as compiler checked
what this is: The whole platform matrix, stated once and in one place: which machines Kaleidoscope is built and published for, which it has been run on, and which have only had a compiler check. /status.json defers to this record rather than repeating it.
